key_claims.claim: Integrated cfDNA exome sequencing achieved approximately 99% sensitivity and specificity compared to amniocentesis for detecting both chromosomal abnormalities and monogenic disorders in a blinded prospective study of 612 pregnancies.

Standardized laser coagulation of the feeding artery in fetal bronchopulmonary sequestration with large pleural effusion yielded 96.6% survival with minimal respiratory morbidity and near-elimination of postnatal resection over 14 years.
Non-invasive prenatal diagnosis for hemoglobinopathies using relative haplotype dosage and relative mutation dosage methods is transitioning from research validation to clinical implementation.

Fetal-fraction enrichment increased mean fetal fraction 2.4-fold, enabling genome-wide NIPT to reliably detect copy number variants down to approximately 1 Mb across all BMI categories in over 10,500 singleton pregnancies.

Preterm prelabor rupture of membranes following fetoscopic laser or selective fetal reduction in multifetal gestations carries higher positive culture rates and greater ampicillin and macrolide resistance than spontaneous PPROM.
